name: crossword
title: Crossword
description: Daily crosswords in the panel: Crosshare's English minis, and the Turkish papers' kare bulmaca from HaberTürk, Cumhuriyet and Sabah. Every key is saved, so you can leave mid-puzzle and pick up where you were.
author: pal

settings.label: Opens on
settings.description: Whose puzzle the first open shows (when nothing is left half-done), and whose puzzle of the day the Now row offers. Browse has every source as a tab either way.

settings.label: Autocheck
settings.text: Mark a wrong letter the moment it is typed
settings.description: Also on ⌘K. A solve with autocheck on is marked as checked in the history.

settings.label: Today's mini in Now
settings.text: A row in the root's Now section while today's mini is unsolved
settings.description: Only once you have solved a puzzle, and gone as soon as today's is solved.

settings.label: Clock
settings.text: Show the time while you play
settings.description: Off hides the running time. Your times still count for stats and show when you finish. Also ⌘T or ⌘K in the game.

store.tagline: Daily crosswords: Crosshare's minis and the Turkish papers' kare bulmaca
features: Today's Crosshare mini, or a kare bulmaca from HaberTürk, Cumhuriyet or Sabah; Next goes to another unplayed one
The NYT Mini's keys: type to fill, `space` turns, `tab` walks the clues
Turkish letters typed on a US keyboard: `c` where Ç goes shows Ç
Check or reveal a square, a word or the grid; a clock that runs only while the grid is on screen
A calendar of past puzzles per source, marked solved, started or new
Stats per source: best and average times, daily streaks, a chart of recent solves
A dated puzzle solved without a reveal goes on its own leaderboard; signed in to a pal account, the stats and streaks follow you to every machine

screenshots.caption: Today's mini mid-solve: the clue you are on above the lists, the crossing clue lit
Solved: the time, the best, the streak, Next puzzle on Enter
The daily minis month by month, solved and started marked
Stats: best and average, the streak, recent times

actions.title: Next puzzle
actions.description: Another unplayed mini: today's if it is still open, then back through the dailies, then the newest minis.

actions.title: Skip this puzzle
actions.description: Next, the first open and the Now row pass it by from then on; opening it from Browse takes the skip back.

actions.title: Browse puzzles
actions.description: The daily minis by month, or the newest minis.

actions.title: Check word
actions.description: Also the square (⌘⌥E) and the grid (⌘G, or Enter once the grid is full but not right).

actions.title: Reveal word
actions.description: Also the square (⌘⌥U) and the grid (⌘⇧U).

actions.title: Show every clue
actions.description: Over a wide grid with no room for the lists beside it.

actions.title: Pause
actions.description: Stops the clock and hides the grid.

actions.title: Hide the clock
actions.description: No running time on screen; again to bring it back. Times still count.

crossword.title: Crossword
crossword.description: The puzzle left half-done, else today's of the source you chose. Escape leaves at any point; every key is saved.

keys.title: Type a letter: fills the square and moves on
Clear the square, or step back and clear
Move (an arrow across the word turns first)
